text_block_list.text: A few weeks before the Satsuki Sho began—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Are the rumors about Sirius Symboli
skipping the Satsuki Sho... for real!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really?
I wonder why. Did she get into a fight and get suspended, or...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"I heard she got into an argument with someone from the URA, though...
I mean, she's definitely a little intimidating, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what? Weren't you stopped by President Rudolf
because of your awful behavior?

For some reason, rumors were flying all over the academy
about Sirius Symboli skipping the Satsuki Sho,
along with all sorts of wild speculation.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: No, leave it alone.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Most likely, people blew the fact that I hadn't been outside for a while out of proportion, and it spread in some weird way.

...Indeed. To tell the truth, I felt a slight discomfort
in my leg a few days ago, so I have been quietly resting.

The rumor is completely false, and there's no plan to withdraw from the race.
That's precisely why one would think having untrue things spread around would bother her, but—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: More importantly, they said upper body training is possible starting today.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Bring the stuff written here from the academy.
choice_data_list: I see... You really don't mind, huh.
I see... You really don't mind, do you?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
Like hell I would.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Bad reputation or whatever,
it's the kinda thing that'll vanish once I race anyway.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: If not, we just have to make them understand.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"An Umamusume who runs like that
would never scratch a race," they said.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...If you understand, then about-face.
If you make it back within two hours, I'll give you headpats.

And so, Sirius Symboli calmly dedicated herself
to recuperation without wavering—

She had successfully managed to
secure a spot in the Satsuki Sho without issue.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Now, to all you noisy, whining rabble—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: I'll show 'em what I'm made of.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: The first crown is mine... Kneel before the name of Sirius Symboli.
